claims.assertion: Anéeka says two planets orbiting Vega are central to Lyran history and humanlike expansion, though other species cite Triangulum origins.
claims.speaker: Anéeka

claims.assertion: Relaying Swaruu accounts, she says humanity has no single evolutionary birthplace but has existed eternally as an expression of the whole.
claims.speaker: Anéeka (relaying Swaruu accounts)
claims.qualifiers: This follows a non-linear, quantum-time model.
